title: Secured Finance in-block price-ratio collateral inflation is net-negative (min-debt floor x 125% threshold)
closed_reasons: Required collateral is 1.25 x max(orderPrice, currentMinDebtUnitPrice) per unit of future value; a claim is worth at most par, so breakeven needs the effective price < 8000.
Best TRADEABLE book today is USDC maturity 1853798400: minBorrow 8075, M(now) 8267 -> required 1.0334 x FV -> -3.337%.
Fork test: a resting borrow of FV 19,000 USDC requires 19,634.125 USDC of collateral; 1 wei less reverts NotEnoughCollateral(); edge = -635.1 USDC.
The prior '2.4% short' figure belongs to USDC maturity 1861660800, which is not tradeable (isReady=false, MarketNotOpened).
Live floors: USDC 8900, WBTC 9300, ETH 9100, JPYC 9100; USDT/DAI/FIL/USDFC/iFIL/wFIL have no lending market.
key_facts: Controller proxy 0x35e9D8e0223A75E51a67aa731127C91Ea0779Fe2 impl 0x558084fFf061196EC4b2a9100c0f6e3fc47B202f (unchanged since block 26,251,756); TokenVault 0xB74749b2213916b1dA3b869E41c7c57f1db69393 impl 0x9a1dc892f4ff89ad7332f62b500fc9ad17d792a3
Balances identical to the pass6 read of 2026-10-23 (no deposits/withdrawals since)
USDC book 1853798400: minBorrow 8075, M(now) 8267, mup 9075 -> effective price 8267 -> -3.337%
USDC book 1861660800: M 8092, minBorrow 8191 -> -2.39% but isReady()=false (not tradeable)
getMinDebtUnitPriceAt = 9600 - (9600-configured)*(maturity-now)/1yr; breakeven M<8000 requires T>2.286y (maturity after ~2029-02-13) or configured USDC floor <8840
Max theoretical loss on the whole USDC leg = $636.26 (attacker needs ~$35k of capital)
pass6's FV-mint engine (cleanUpOrders) remains fixed; this re-check covers the separate collateral-inflation vector
CurrencyController.getHaircut(USDC) = 0, so an unallocated claim is not counted as collateral in the solvency path; the benefit is strictly below FV, making the loss >= 3.34%
caveats: The -3.34% figure is the most generous bound (claim valued 1:1); with getHaircut(USDC)=0 the unallocated claim contributes no collateral, so the true edge is more negative.
The up-ratchet cost from mup 9075 to 10000 is taken from prior fork work (~9 blocks, ~$100 notional/step), not re-measured here.
getCurrentMinDebtUnitPrice depends on block.timestamp and drifts ~+0.0002%/day toward safety as maturities approach.
minDebtUnitPrice is owner-settable (owner 0xccAC3163E54847ae04f192a20DCf2E902C660312), so the re-arm condition is partly privileged.
one_liner: Secured Finance's in-block price-ratio collateral inflation is still live in code but loses 3.34% on the best tradeable book (max loss $636 on the USDC leg); external unprivileged extraction is $0 today and needs a book maturing after ~2029-02 or a lower owner-set floor to re-arm.
